claims.statement: Left Milan for Rome on 24 September 1513 and lived in the Belvedere at the Vatican under Giuliano de' Medici.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: His own note on the departure; Vatican payment lists.
